manifest.title: On the importance of initialization and momentum in deep learning
manifest.venue: Proceedings of the 30th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 28(3), 1139–1147

claims.paraphrase: Classical momentum accumulates a velocity in directions where the loss keeps falling.

anchor.quote: is a technique for accelerating gradient descent that accumulates a velocity vector in directions of persistent reduction in the objective across iterations

claims.paraphrase: Directions of low curvature persist across steps, and momentum amplifies them.

anchor.quote: they will tend to persist across iterations and be amplified by CM

claims.paraphrase: Both methods decay the velocity and add a gradient-based correction to it.

anchor.quote: both CM and NAG compute the new velocity by applying a gradient-based correction to the previous velocity vector (which is decayed)

claims.paraphrase: Nesterov's method first moves part of the way, then takes the gradient there.

anchor.quote: NAG first performs a partial update

claims.paraphrase: Nesterov's method behaves more stably than classical momentum, especially at high momentum.

anchor.quote: letting it behave more stably than CM in many situations, especially for higher values of μ

claims.paraphrase: On an oblong bowl, classical momentum oscillates across the steep direction; Nesterov's method all but avoids it.

anchor.quote: While the optimization path taken by CM exhibits large oscillations along the high-curvature vertical direction, NAG is able to avoid these oscillations almost entirely

claims.paraphrase: So Nesterov's method tolerates larger momentum than classical momentum does.

anchor.quote: thus making NAG more tolerant of large values of μ compared to CM

claims.paraphrase: The paper's own two-dimensional example: an oblong quadratic, both methods with the same constants.

anchor.quote: a two-dimensional oblong quadratic objective, both with the same momentum and learning rate constants

claims.paraphrase: Late in training, both methods' aggressiveness prevents fine convergence.

anchor.quote: the overly aggressive nature of CM or NAG would prevent this

claims.paraphrase: Both the initialization and the momentum are crucial.

anchor.quote: We find that both the initialization and the momentum are crucial

claims.paraphrase: Well-initialized networks train markedly worse when momentum is absent or poorly tuned.

anchor.quote: well-initialized networks perform markedly worse when the momentum is absent or poorly tuned
